summary: Organization owners can now let people work on repository security advisories, including private vulnerability reports, through custom repository roles . You no longer have to make them repository administrators or give them the organization-wide security manager role.
takeaways: You no longer have to make them repository administrators or give them the organization-wide security manager role.
A few things to know: Merging changes from a temporary private fork still requires a repository administrator or security manager.
This is available to organizations on plans that support custom repository roles, including GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
